remarks: Exceptional just minutes from the beach, village shops and restaurants, Metro-North, and many of the neighborhood's most sought-after destinations. Set on a quiet street, this inviting single-family home offers the rare combination of privacy and convenience in coveted Old Greenwich. The home has been freshly updated with brand-new white quartz kitchen counters and new paint throughout most of the interior. Outside, enjoy a private, level backyard with a stone patio, ideal for relaxing or outdoor dining. Close to Old Greenwich Elementary School, the Eastern Greenwich Civic Center, golf courses, Upper Crust, Garden Catering, downtown Old Greenwich, and the Metro-North station. Rent includes 3-4 organic lawn fertilizer applications per year. Pets permitted with some restrictions. An exceptional opportunity to enjoy one of Greenwich's most desirable neighborhoods with the beach, village, schools, dining, recreation, and train all close to home.
